FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.PageDescription: Delete visits by website, date range and segment, for example bot traffic or test data. Check the matches first; large deletions continue in the background.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.NoVisitsFound: No visits found matching the filter.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.BatchSizeHelp: Number of visits to delete per batch. Higher values are faster but use more memory.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.SegmentFilterHelp: Matomo segment syntax: a comma means OR, a semicolon means AND. Example: visitIp==192.0.2.10,visitIp==192.0.2.11;browserCode!=FF
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.WarningText: Deleting visits is permanent and cannot be undone. Archives will be invalidated and need to be re-processed. Make sure you have a database backup.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorInvalidDate: Invalid date "%1$s". Please use the format YYYY-MM-DD.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorDateOrder: The start date must not be after the end date.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorDateTooEarly: The start date must not be before %1$s.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorDateInFuture: The end date must not be in the future.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorSegmentInvalidForSites: The segment cannot be used for these websites: %1$s
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorSegmentTooLong: The segment is too long (at most %1$s characters).
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorSegmentMatchesEverything: The segment contains no valid condition and would match every visit.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.MessageSiteSkipped: Website %1$s no longer exists and was skipped.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorJobStateChange: Deletion job %1$s cannot be changed in status "%2$s".
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorQueuedBehindRunningJob: Another deletion is currently running. Your deletion was queued as job %1$s and continues in the background (or via the console command feinwerkdeletevisitsfilter:work).
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.SettingBackgroundBudgetHelp: How long deletions may continue in the background each hour, e.g. after the page was closed. 0 turns background processing off: deletions then only run while the page is open or via the console command. Allowed: 0 or 60 to 3300.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.SettingBackgroundBudgetInvalid: Please enter 0 or a value between 60 and 3300.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.SettingDefaultBatchSizeHelp: Number of visits deleted per step (100 to 10000).
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.SettingDefaultBatchSizeInvalid: Please enter a value between 100 and 10000.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ActivityJobCancelled: cancelled visit deletion job %1$s (%2$s visits deleted until then)
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.RequestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.HeldHint: This deletion is on hold because it would delete more visits than allowed.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.CancelJobConfirm: Cancel this deletion? Visits deleted so far stay deleted.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ConnectionError: The progress could not be updated (%1$s). Trying again in 10 seconds.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.BusyHint: Another process (for example the console or the hourly background task) is working on the deletions right now. The progress is updated every 5 seconds.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.BackgroundHint: You can close this page: the deletion continues in the background.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.BackgroundOffHint: Background processing is switched off. Keep this page open or run the console command %1$s.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.DateRangeTimezoneHint: The days are counted in each website's time zone.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ActionLevelHint: This segment refers to actions (for example pages). Whole visits with all their actions are deleted, not only the matching actions.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ConfirmIrreversible: This cannot be undone. The reports of the affected days will be processed again.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ConfirmTypeCount: To confirm, please type the number of visits (%1$s):
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.ErrorSegmentEmptyValue: A condition of the segment has no value. Please fill it in or remove the condition.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.DetailsSteps: Steps: %1$s · days to be processed again: %2$s · batch size: %3$s
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.TemplateApplied: The settings of deletion %1$s were applied. Please check the matches before deleting.
FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.RetryJobConfirm: Continue deletion %1$s? %2$s visits have been deleted so far; the rest of the matching visits will be deleted.

FeinwerkDeleteVisitsFilter.FeedbackThanksDown: Thank you. If you like, describe the problem to our support.
